d:
The hunt for gold pushes the miners to their limits as they battle equipment breakdowns, difficult mining conditions and risky decisions that could make or break their season. With huge investments on the line and every ounce of gold counting, Todd Hoffman, Parker Schnabel and their crews must find ways to keep their operations running and turn their hard work into profit. But after all the setbacks and sacrifices, will the gold they find make it worth the struggle?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 2, 6, 8, 10, 16, 11 and 7, on Discovery Channel India.
